faqs.question: What does the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Pus, Abscess, and Aspirates test measure?
faqs.answer: The AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Pus, Abscess, and Aspirates test detects Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB Complex) or Non-Tuberculosis Bacteria (NTM or MOTT) in samples of pus, abscesses, or aspirates.

faqs.question: Why is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Pus, Abscess, and Aspirates test done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose infections caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis or Non-Tuberculosis Bacteria • To determine the appropriate treatment for these infections • To monitor the effectiveness of treatment • To prevent the spread of these bacteria to others

faqs.question: When is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Pus, Abscess, and Aspirates test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: The AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Pus, Abscess, and Aspirates test is recommended when there is a suspicion of infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis or Non-Tuberculosis Bacteria. It is suitable for patients presenting with symptoms such as persistent cough, fever, weight loss, night sweats, or people at higher risk due to exposure to infected individuals.

faqs.question: What if the results of the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Pus, Abscess, and Aspirates test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results of the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Pus, Abscess, and Aspirates test may indicate the presence of Mycobacterium tuberculosis or Non-Tuberculosis Bacteria, suggesting an ongoing infection.

faqs.question: What to expect during the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Pus, Abscess, and Aspirates test?
faqs.answer: • A 2 ml sample of pus, abscess, or aspirate will be collected in a sterile leak-proof container. • The sample will be sent to the laboratory for processing and culture.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Pus, Abscess, and Aspirates test?
faqs.answer: Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Pus, Abscess, and Aspirates test?
faqs.answer: • Acid-Fast Bacilli Stain: This test helps identify acid-fast bacteria in samples. • GeneXpert MTB/RIF assay: It detects the DNA of Mycobacterium tuberculosis and tests for drug resistance. • Chest X-ray: This imaging test can help evaluate lung involvement in tuberculosis infections.

faqs.question: What is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – Pus, Abscess, and Aspirates test also known as?
faqs.answer: Acid-Fast Bacilli Rapid Culture by Mycobacteria Growth Indicator Tube method

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis (TB) is a contagious bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. It primarily affects the lungs but can also involve other parts of the body. TB can cause symptoms like persistent cough, fever, weight loss, night sweats, and fatigue. Early diagnosis and treatment are crucial to prevent its spread and complications.
